newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis has strong growth in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Novartis has strong growth in early 1997.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals and life sciences group Novartis AG said on Tuesday it experienced dynamic growth in all of its divisions in the first two months of 1997.
Currency translation effects were also positive, it added.

Key factors contributing to the increases were growth of new and existing products, merger-related synergies and a high net liquidity position, which totalled 6.186 billion Swiss francs in 1996 as compared to 3.619 billion the prior year, the group said in a statement.
Novartis was formed through the merger of Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz AG.
